scenario: A banner is created as a draft with safe defaults; unsafe input is refused
steps: 1. POST /banners with slug, purpose, message, placement 2. POST the same slug again 3. POST with HTML, a line break, 281 characters, a javascript: link, a // link, a label without a url, an end before the start, a bad placement, priority 101, an unknown field, a cohort audience without a slug 4. POST with an audience cohort that does not exist
expected: 201 draft with style info, audience all, dismissible true, priority 0; duplicate 409; every unsafe input 400 and nothing stored; unknown cohort 422

scenario: Update needs If-Match; null clears the link; the audience can be a real cohort
steps: 1. PATCH without If-Match 2. PATCH with a wrong version 3. PATCH with {} 4. PATCH with slug 5. PATCH message, link, priority and a cohort audience 6. PATCH ctaUrl null alone 7. PATCH ctaLabel and ctaUrl null 8. PATCH a start after the end
expected: 428; 409; 400; 400; 200 with version 2; 400 (label without link); 200 and the link is gone; 400

scenario: Life cycle: publish, unpublish, archive, restore, delete; every change audited
steps: 1. unpublish a draft 2. publish 3. publish again 4. DELETE while published 5. unpublish, archive, restore 6. DELETE 7. GET /audit?resource=banner
expected: 422; 200; 422; 422; 200 each; 200 then 404; audit lists create, update, publish, unpublish, archive, restore, delete

scenario: The four keys read as defaults; values are range checked; the first save needs no version
steps: 1. GET /settings 2. PUT dailyEmailCap and __proto__ 3. PUT out-of-range, text, null and bad phone or e-mail values 4. PUT {} and an extra field 5. PUT daily-email-cap 300 6. PUT again without If-Match, with a stale one, with the right one
expected: Four items with defaults; 404; 400 each; 400; 201 version 1; 428; 409; 200 version 2

scenario: One announcement may not exceed the daily total; phone and e-mail set and cleared; audited
steps: 1. Lower daily-email-cap below the announcement cap 2. Raise announcement-email-cap to 200, then lower daily below it 3. Lower announcement, then daily 4. Set and clear support-phone, set support-email 5. GET /audit?resource=setting
expected: 422 each time the rule is broken and nothing stored; 200 when consistent; phone cleared to null; e-mail lower-cased; audit has create and update with before and after

scenario: Built-in text until saved; bad placeholders and subjects refused; versioned saves
steps: 1. GET /email-templates 2. GET an unknown key 3. PUT with an unknown placeholder, a two-line subject, no body, an empty subject, an unfinished placeholder, an extra field, 5,001 characters 4. PUT a valid template, again without If-Match, stale, valid
expected: Three templates from the built-in text; 404; 400 each and nothing saved; 201 version 1; 428; 409; 200 version 2; audited

scenario: Preview renders with sample values, escapes everything, saves and sends nothing
steps: 1. POST preview with no body 2. POST preview with a script tag, a javascript: link and an img tag in the body 3. POST preview with a placeholder the template does not have 4. POST invalid JSON 5. GET the template
expected: Saved text rendered with links as anchors; no script, img or anchor in the hostile output (shown as <script>); 400; 400; version unchanged

scenario: A staff key can read and preview but not change banners, settings or templates
preconditions: An API key of level staff
steps: 1. GET banners, settings, email-templates 2. POST preview 3. POST /banners, PATCH, publish, PUT /settings, PUT /email-templates
expected: 200 for reads and preview; 403 for every write; nothing changed

scenario: Create with safe defaults; unsafe input and rule breaks refused
steps: 1. POST /notifications for a cohort 2. POST with an HTML title, a 2,001-character body, a javascript: link, a recipients list, an admins target for a normal type, an admin alert for everyone, an expiry before publish, marketing or progress with email, no inbox, a scheduled e-mail, an unknown cohort
expected: 201 live, channels inbox, no e-mail sent; 400 or 422 for each refusal and nothing stored

scenario: List by status; an inbox item can be scheduled; admin alert for admins
steps: 1. Create one scheduled for later, one admin alert 2. GET ?status=scheduled, live, expired 3. GET ?status=sometimes 4. Page with limit=2 and the cursor
expected: Each status shows the right ones; 400 for a bad status; paging has no repeats

scenario: Reads are a count only; delete removes the read marks
steps: 1. GET /notifications/{id} 2. DELETE it 3. GET again 4. GET with a bad id
expected: readCount 1 and no user id in the answer; 200; 404; 404

scenario: Recipients: a count and a sample of at most 5
preconditions: A cohort with two enrolled learners
steps: 1. GET recipients for the cohort, a single user, everyone
expected: count 2 with 2 samples (name and e-mail only); count 1; everyone has a count and no sample

scenario: The e-mail send refuses every bad case and sends nothing
steps: 1. send-email on an inbox-only notification 2. Set announcement-email-cap to 1 and send-email for the 2-person cohort 3. Check the notification and the audit
expected: 422 each; emailSentAt and emailRecipients stay empty; no send-email audit entry

scenario: Only the owner sends e-mail; an admin key creates and deletes; a staff key reads
preconditions: An admin key and a staff key
steps: 1. send-email with each key 2. create and delete with the admin key 3. read with the staff key, write with it
expected: 403 for send with both keys; 201 and 200 for the admin key; 200 for staff reads; 403 for staff writes

scenario: A real send reaches exactly the target, once (manual)
preconditions: Gmail configured; two test learners in a test cohort; announcement-email-cap at least 2
steps: 1. Create an announcement for the test cohort with channels inbox and email 2. GET recipients and check the sample 3. POST send-email as the owner 4. Check both inboxes 5. POST send-email again
expected: One e-mail each, From the academy address, no other recipient visible; the second call is 409; sent is 2; the audit has send-email; the daily budget row for today grew by 2
